summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory by name. Changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.description: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path like /etc/passwd escapes UPLOAD_DIR, because os.path.join discards the base for absolute names. Any client can read any file the server process can read. That includes secrets, config files and source code. Serve the file with send_from_directory, which rejects paths outside the base. Alternatively, resolve the path and check that it stays under UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.fix: Serve the file with send_from_directory, which rejects paths outside the base. Alternatively, resolve the path and check that it stays under UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.title: Debug mode enabled on a public bind
findings.description: The change starts the app with debug=True and binds it to 0.0.0.0. This exposes the interactive Werkzeug debugger to the network. Anyone who reaches port 5000 and triggers an error can try to run arbitrary code through the debugger console. Debug pages also leak stack traces and local values. Keep debug off by default and read it from an environment variable. Keep the default bind at 127.0.0.1.

findings.title: Server bind widened to all interfaces
findings.description: The change moves the bind from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0. The development server now accepts connections from every network interface. Other hosts on the network can reach the development server and the new download endpoint. Before this change, only local clients could reach it. Keep 127.0.0.1 as the default. Make the host configurable through an environment variable if remote access is needed.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no tests
findings.description: The repository has no tests for the new download handler. Nothing checks the 404 path or the rejection of traversal attempts. Future changes could break or weaken the file access check without anyone noticing. Add tests that cover a valid file, a missing file and a traversal name such as ../etc/passwd.
